C0183.title: Man Sentenced to 8 Months for 712 Malicious Food Delivery Refund Scams
C0183.summary: Between August 2020 and May 2022, a man surnamed Zhang exploited loopholes in Meituan Waimai's compensation rules, filing 712 fraudulent claims for multiple damages citing food safety and product quality issues.
